headline: Number of microloan borrowers in Kyrgyzstan has tripled since the beginning of the year
summary: Microloans issued by non-bank financial credit organizations in Kyrgyzstan rose 24.5% in January-September 2026 from a year earlier. The number of borrowers has tripled since the start of the year.
why: Non-bank lenders extend small consumer and business credit that supports household spending and informal-sector activity in lower-income economies.
original_headline: Число заемщиков микрокредитов в Кыргызстане выросло в 3 раза с начала года
